stem.text: The volume of water in a pond changes at a rate modeled by \( v(t) = 25\sin\left(\frac{t^{2}}{18}\right) - 6 \) cubic meters per day, where \( t \) is measured in days and \( 0 \le t \le 10 \). Let \( V(t) \) be the volume of water, in cubic meters, in the pond at time \( t \). At time \( t = 0 \) the pond holds 800 cubic meters of water.

parts.prompt: Find the average rate of change of \( V \) over the interval \( 0 \le t \le 6 \).

worked_solution.text: V(6) - V(0) is the integral of v over [0, 6]; divide by the length 6.

points.criterion: Writes the definite integral of v(t) from t = 0 to t = 6 divided by 6, in any equivalent form such as (V(6) - V(0))/6 with V(6) - V(0) written as that integral. An average value of V itself, or (v(6) - v(0))/6, earns nothing.
Gives 6.470 cubic meters per day, accurate to three decimal places.

parts.prompt: Find the time \( t \), with \( 0 < t < 6 \), at which the instantaneous rate of change of \( V \) equals the average rate of change of \( V \) over the interval \( 0 \le t \le 6 \).

worked_solution.text: The instantaneous rate of change of V is v(t). Set it equal to the average rate of change.

points.criterion: Writes the equation v(t) = (1/6) times the integral of v from 0 to 6, with the right side as that expression or as its value from part (a), about 6.470.
Gives t = 3.066 days, accurate to three decimal places.

parts.prompt: There is exactly one number \( k \), with \( 6 < k \le 10 \), for which the average rate of change of \( V \) over the interval \( 0 \le t \le k \) is 0. Find \( k \).

worked_solution.text: The average rate of change over [0, k] is the integral of v from 0 to k divided by k. Set it equal to 0.
Solve on the calculator for k between 6 and 10.

points.criterion: Writes the equation (1/k) times the integral of v(t) from 0 to k equals 0, or the equivalent equation that the integral of v(t) from 0 to k equals 0, or V(k) = V(0) with V(k) written as 800 plus that integral.
Gives k = 9.659, accurate to three decimal places.

parts.prompt: Find the average rate of change of \( V \) over the interval \( 6 \le t \le 10 \). Then find the time \( t \), with \( 6 < t < 10 \), at which the instantaneous rate of change of \( V \) equals this average rate of change.

worked_solution.text: Set v(t) equal to that value.
Solve on the calculator for t between 6 and 10.

points.criterion: Writes the definite integral of v(t) from t = 6 to t = 10 divided by 4, the length of the interval.
Gives the average rate of change -11.898 cubic meters per day, accurate to three decimal places, supported by the setup from d1. A positive value earns nothing.
Gives t = 7.800 days (7.799 by truncation), as the solution of v(t) equal to the average rate of change over [6, 10].
